scientific_diagnosis.v1_ranking_conclusion: RegisteredEvidenceToUnaryV1 improved every held-out validation prompt AP and improved macro AP, AUROC, oracle IoU, fixed-threshold IoU, precision, recall, and BCE.
scientific_diagnosis.v1_only_macro_promotion_failure: candidate predicted-to-target area ratio was 1.8404688245563001, outside the frozen [0.8,1.25] interval, although it improved from the analytic 2.104796498945095
scientific_diagnosis.mechanism_hypothesis: class-balanced BCE learned useful ordering but imposed an artificial equal-class decision prior; a proper-BCE two-parameter global monotone calibration can repair probability scale without changing ranking

method.name: GlobalPromptLogitCalibratorV2
method.scope: post-render supported-pixel scalar calibration after the frozen graph-off V1 primitive unary and exact scalar renderer
method.ranking_invariant: strictly increasing scalar transform for every finite input because temperature is positive; AP, AUROC, and oracle IoU must be preserved up to numeric tolerance

fit.instances: the 17 frozen V1 train instance IDs only
fit.views: all frozen source-distinct held-out target views of train instances
fit.labels: binary official instance membership for the corresponding train instance and target view
fit.loss: ordinary unweighted pixel-micro binary cross entropy (proper BCE)
fit.optimizer: deterministic full-batch LBFGS with strong-Wolfe line search

evaluation.instances: the same four frozen V1 validation instance IDs [1,12,20,21]
evaluation.target_views: the same source-distinct held-out target views as V1

promotion_gate.failure_action: stop before every benchmark target metric
